title: Structural Silence: When AI Infrastructure Fails Speakers of Underrepresented Languages
summary: Structural Silence: When AI Infrastructure Fails Speakers of Underrepresented Languages｜Artificial intelligence tools for education and language support are increasingly framed as

extra.description: Artificial intelligence tools for education and language support are increasingly framed as scalable responses to access gaps in under-resourced communities. Yet the infrastructure underlying these tools, including training corpora, tokenization schemes, evaluation benchmarks, and deployment architectures, can systematically disadvantage speakers of underrepresented languages before a model is trained.
